metadata.title: FDA E2B(R3) Reporting Scenarios
metadata.topic: E2B regional data and business rules
metadata.legal_basis: FDA FAERS/AEMS E2B(R3) reporting scenarios sheet; lists key data elements per scenario; undated, check FDA for a newer file
metadata.applicability: Reference text; the scenarios are captured by the E2B importer, not the PDF collector

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.

candidates.statement: E2B(R3) - Reporting Scenarios This document lists different scenarios for reporting Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) to FAERS. These scenarios identify the key ICH and regional data elements that must be populated for the ICSRs to be accepted.
candidates.context: Scenario 1: Premarket report on an IND or IND-Exempt BA/BE study

candidates.statement: Study Type Where Reaction(s) / Event(s) Were Observed (C.5.4) = 2 (Individual patient use) or 3 (Other studies) * Must be used to describe the drug’s role in the IND-Exempt BA/BE study. Use nullFlavor 'NA' for all other drugs or if information is not available.
candidates.context: OR Pre-ANDA Number where AE Occurred (C.5.5b) = <Pre-ANDA Number> FDA Additional Information on Drug (coded) (FDA.G.k.10a) * = 1 (Test) or 2(Reference) Scenario 2: Solicited reports or reports from Organized Data Collection System Batch Receiver Identifier (N.1.4) = ZZFDA Message Receiver Identifier (N.2.r.3) = CDER Scenario 3: Premarket AGGREGRATE report

candidates.statement: Scenario 6: Postmarket study report - Must submit two (2) reports 1) on the IND and 2) on the NDA or BLA Report 1 Batch Receiver Identifier (N.1.4) = ZZFDA_PREMKT Message Receiver Identifier (N.2.r.3) = CDER_IND or CBER_IND
candidates.context: Message Receiver Identifier (N.2.r.3) = CDER_IND or CBER_IND Type of Report (C.1.3) = 1 (Spontaneous) Report 2 Batch Receiver Identifier (N.1.4) = ZZFDA Message Receiver Identifier (N.2.r.3) = CDER
